mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month growth > 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 2% YoY signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 4% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST levels are consistently high and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below -1% YoY signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -1% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
